description: The Colorado Energy Office provides monthly electricity-use records for facilities used by state agencies. The source states that coverage begins in fiscal year 2015. Documented columns identify the building, department, year, month, energy type and energy usage. The field definition specifies electricity usage in kilowatt-hours and distinguishes electricity and lighting categories. These facility-level demand observations can support building-energy demand models and infrastructure capacity studies. The provider metadata reports the last data update in April 2018; it does not establish current agency consumption or the final month represented. Meter boundaries, missing observations and comparability between building categories were not established from the catalogue metadata. The public portal and JSON catalogue metadata are free to access. The licence is Public Domain. Legacy CSV export checks returned HTTP 410; current distribution access remains unverified. No dataset rows were downloaded. Related records include the parent open-data catalogue for Colorado.
